formattedAddress: No. 25號, Lane 77, Section 1, Chengde Rd, Jiantai Village, Datong District, Taipei City, Taiwan 103

text.text: Great cafe, there was no wait on a Saturday morning. There’s a nice sit down area in front of the baristas and they have a very nice black modern interior design. The ceramic cup they provided for me was also handmade by them, which was very cool. The staff were very kind to explain their drinks. I ordered a breakfast set which has a coffee of the day and a pastry that goes with it (~260NTD). For the price, it was definitely a worthwhile experience.

Coffee was soooo light. She kindly made another one for me with less milk but it was still not to my taste at all. Just tasted like flavoured milk

Highly recommend you go to syzygy coffee nearby or simply kaffa near huashan - so much better if you are used to specialty coffee houses in Europe and other parts of Asia.

text.text: Store is nicely decorated and I enjoyed drinking coffee here. I did enjoy my cup of coffee with tonic. The girl that helped me with my order was very friendly and spoke English. She asked me what I thought of the coffee and showed that they care about their patrons. It’s located in a quiet small street and MRT station is very close by. I would visit again.

text.text: I went to the Zhongshan branch 2 days in a row.  It recently celebrated its 2nd anniversary, while the mother branch has been open for 7 years now.  This is a place for true coffee lovers— I come from Bangkok which has a great specialty coffee culture, and I was very pleased here in Taipei!   Beautiful minimalist style place.  I walked in and was attended by a barista whose English was excellent.  She explained the various coffee drinks available.  They have many single origin coffees, mostly Ethiopian (but not exclusively), available in espresso or pour over.   I chose an Ethiopian pour over.  The barista knows her stuff.  She explained to me the ratio of coffee to water she would chose, her pour over method/ steps, the effect of varying temperature of the final beverage on taste and how to enjoy my coffee best with the type of cup they have to drink from.  Very competent.  It’s a slow service place (not in a bad way): if you arrive and the baristas are busy making time sensitive coffee drinks, they will simply ask you to wait some time, so they do not have to interrupt the brewing process of the specialty coffees.  I appreciated that a lot.  Both of my coffees were delicious, with indeed varying & different taste profiles as the coffee got colder.  And the barista took the same care in explaining all the details to other customers, which makes for a very personal type of service!   This made me return the next day to try other beans!  After enjoying my coffee slowly, so as to not affect tasting the brew, I ordered a slice of their delicious carrot cake, not to be missed if you are hungry.   Yes I do hope i see you again!

text.text:
The coffee was delicious, but at 160 TWD I expect more than a thimbleful….it was more of an espresso macchiato than cappuccino. Two sips and it’s gone. This makes it crazily expensive.

I wouldn’t return, despite the nice location.
